children: Chinese AI auto insurance and services provider's first half revenue grew 24% yr/yr to $277 mln
Net income improved to $3.4 mln from a $5.5 mln net loss last year
Adjusted EBITDA rose 276% yr/yr to $9.4 mln, reflecting improved operating performance
SunCar continues to forecast full-year 2026 revenue at approximately $600 mln
EV INSURANCE PREMIUMS - Co said 31% yr/yr growth in EV insurance premiums contributed to revenue gains
AUTO SERVICES SEGMENT - Co said 22% yr/yr growth in auto services revenue was its strongest segment growth since reporting began
AI INTEGRATION - Co said operational efficiency improved by 45% and error rates fell 80% after integrating AI into operations
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the online services peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for SunCar Technology Group Inc is $5.00, about 930.5% above its September 21 closing price of $0.49
The stock recently traded at 3 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 5 three months ago
